verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents bank-hosted OAuth connections, any list of institutions covered by OAuth, or a plan to retire credential-based flows. The available signals point the other way: the sandbox simulates an in-Connect OTP MFA flow, and community comments describe users handing their bank credentials to Teller. The mTLS/TAuth material concerns how API callers authenticate to Teller, not how end users link their banks, so it does not count toward this story.
